name: 41008 · Carrollton, KY
findings: ZIP 41008 (Carrollton) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 41008 (Carrollton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
